card.name: Partway through dose and adverse words
card.fires_on: Responds to the word 'of' after 'dose' before a drug name, and to the middle of 'inhaled' and 'Adverse' in cross-references like [see Adverse Reactions]. It also fires on 'dose' after 'recommended'.

modes.label: 'of' after dose
modes.description: The word 'of' right after 'dose' and before a drug name in interaction or dosing text.
modes.example: The recommended dose<< of>> dolutegravir is 5

modes.label: Inside 'inhaled'
modes.description: The middle of 'inhaled' in phrases about inhaled drugs or corticosteroids.
modes.example: As with other in<<haled>> drugs containing beta 2 -adre

modes.label: Inside 'Adverse'
modes.description: The 'verse' part of 'Adverse' in 'Adverse Reactions' headings and section references.
